response: Starting today, Saved Views is live for every customer on a paid plan. Instead of rebuilding filters and sorts each time you open a project, save the exact configuration you want and return to it in one click. Share any saved view with your team, so everyone works from the same setup without repeating manual steps. Saved Views is included at no extra cost in all paid plans, with no setup required beyond your first save. Whether you're tracking overdue tasks, high-priority bugs, or a specific client's projects, this feature keeps your most useful views ready whenever you need them. It's available now, so there's no waiting to try it out. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
